ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food chain from left to right: on the far left are small aquatic organisms, with an arrow pointing to a small fish; the small fish then points through an arrow to a larger fish; the larger fish points through an arrow to a longer predatory fish; finally, an arrow points from this long predatory fish to the bird on the far right. Reasoning: The arrows in the food chain indicate that the previous organism is eaten by the following organism. The arrow entering the bird comes from the predatory fish, so the bird feeds on the predatory fish.
